name: co-social-contributions
description: Colombian social security contributions of the self-employed (aportes de independientes) for 2026: who must contribute, the contribution base (IBC) of 40% of monthly income under Ley 2277 de 2022 art. 89, for contractors with a contrato de prestación de servicios personales (40% of the monthly contract value) and for independientes por cuenta propia (40% of income after supported costs), the floor of 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) and cap of 25 SMMLV, health 12.5%, pension 16%, the Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional from 4 SMMLV, ARL for contracts over one month, payment month in arrears through PILA by the last two digits of the ID, rounding, pensioners, several contracts, and UGPP checks. Trigger on: seguridad social independientes 2026, IBC independiente, 40% IBC, PILA independiente, salud y pensión contratista, ARL contratista, mes vencido, Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional, UGPP independiente, Colombian self-employed social security.
